r_call: confint.gllvmTMB_multi(object, parm='icc', method=<'wald_asym'|'fisher-z'|'bogus'>) -> .confint_icc(method=...) -> if/else-if/else default branch -> cli_abort('Method ... not supported for icc. Available: wald, bootstrap.'). The default branch is reached WITHOUT ever calling extract_repeatability(), so this reject path needs no two-tier (vB>0, vW>0) fit -- confirmed by reading .confint_icc's branch order directly (only the wald/bootstrap branch calls extract_repeatability).
julia_surface: icc_wald_ci(fit, f; method=<bad>) -- icc_wald_ci declares no `method` keyword, so any of the three bad values raises MethodError at the call site
check: for each of the 3 bad method strings: R raises an error whose message contains 'not supported' and 'icc'; Julia raises MethodError
